0.EN: (We're at the arcade. I wonder if Favna will like it here?)

1.EN:
It's a little loud in here... but that means
it's perfect for concealing my overpowered aura.

2.EN:
...Ah. This effigy of a messenger of the night...
It looks just like the little one.

3.EN:
"Oh, you're right. It's pretty cute.
Have you ever played a crane game before?"

4.EN:
Hmph, this is a game for mere children!
I shall conquer it before you can even blink!

5.EN: Favna boasts as she begins playing the crane game...

6.EN: Urgh... I can see the false god tampering with the gears of fate...

7.EN:
(She's played at least 10 times by now...
Looks like there are things Favna isn't good at after all.)

8.EN:
What are you grinning about?! I have no other choice...
You, familiar! I leave everything in your hands!

9.EN:
You take over for Favna... And by a stroke of luck,
you manage to get the black cat plushie in one try!

10.EN:
To think you would defy even the whims of fate!
Your powers are remarkable!

11.EN: "Thanks. Here you go then. It's yours."

13.EN: I asked~! The shop manager said okay, so it's okay, right?

14.EN: Being a regular really speeds up the whole process~!

15.EN: Well then, should we play some "Magic Angel" before we go?

16.EN: Oh, c'moooon! I can't get anything~!

17.EN:
You come across a pair of high school girls.
They seem to be struggling...

18.EN:
Hey, are you, like, good at crane games?
Can we ask you to give it a shot for us?

21.EN: For real?! Then I'll leave it to you!

22.EN: Awww, that was so close. Try again, try again!

24.EN: Thanks so much! We'll totally repay you another time!

25.EN:
(I'm glad I could help.
But also, have I seen those two before...?)
